question: Will Arsenal become a Ugandan Football team by the end of 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if, by 23:59 UTC on 31 December 2026, Arsenal F.C. (the English Premier League club) has been officially and formally re-registered, relocated, or recognized as a Ugandan football club — i.e., affiliated with the Federation of Uganda Football Associations (FUFA) as a member club in place of, or in addition to, its English Football Association registration.
- "No": Wins if, by 23:59 UTC on 31 December 2026, no such official re-registration, relocation, or recognition of Arsenal F.C. as a Ugandan football club has been confirmed by FUFA or the English Football Association.
